Title: Business Intelligence Architect

Build end to end automated analytical solutions using Power BI, Power Apps and Microsoft Flow. Understand data standards and identify data abnormalities. Instill data quality in all solutions delivered. Maintain close alignment with all customers (internal, external, management and at the field level) and other data reporting teams to ensure requirements are being met. Minimum 7-10 years of experience in related data roles. Skill Excellent skill level in SQL, PL/SQL. In-depth experience with Microsoft analytics Stack (Power BI, Power Query, Fabric, DAX, T-SQL, SSRS, SSAS) Advanced knowledge Power BI. Proficient in DAX, M language. Superior documentation and organizational skills. Must be detail oriented. Excellent critical-thinking skills with the ability to research and analyze data retrieved from multiple sources Must possess and demonstrate excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communications skills. Must be an adaptable self-starter and work with minimal supervision. Must be able to handle multiple projects and organize time effectively. Title: Subdirector en Analítica de Portafolio
Description: Subdirector Analítica de Portafolio Objetivo del Puesto Definir y ejecutar la estrategia analítica del dominio de crédito individual, para que las decisiones del negocio estén respaldadas por análisis rigurosos y relevantes. Responde preguntas estratégicas mediante un pensamiento causal, y convierte los datos en decisiones accionables. Funciones Principales 1. Definir y mantener la agenda analítica del portafolio de crédito individual. Identificar oportunidades de generar valor con datos y traducir los objetivos estratégicos en iniciativas analíticas, priorizadas por impacto, complejidad y urgencia. 2. Priorizar preguntas clave de negocio sobre el portafolio. Identificar y estructurar preguntas estratégicas con base en un entendimiento profundo del portafolio, sus drivers de comportamiento y sus riesgos. 3. Alinear con los stakeholders del dominio de crédito. Mantener comunicación continua con líderes de negocio, riesgo, producto y operaciones para entender sus necesidades, validar hipótesis y asegurar entregables relevantes. 4. Integrar los resultados analíticos en las decisiones operativas. Asegurar que los hallazgos se traduzcan en acciones dentro de procesos, políticas de crédito, originación, cobranza y gestión del portafolio. 5. Gestionar y desarrollar al equipo analítico. Liderar y evaluar al equipo con objetivos claros, mejores prácticas y desarrollo de capacidades técnicas y de negocio, en un ambiente de alto desempeño. 6. Asegurar calidad y rigor metodológico. Definir estándares, mejores prácticas y procesos de validación, y supervisar el uso adecuado de técnicas estadísticas, modelos y datos. 7. Traducir hallazgos complejos en recomendaciones claras. Presentar resultados en mensajes estructurados y orientados a la acción, adaptados a cada audiencia. 8. Colaborar con el Director de Ciencia de Datos. Alinear las iniciativas locales con los estándares y prioridades globales, y adaptar los modelos globales al contexto local. 9. Monitorear KPIs del portafolio. Dar seguimiento a los indicadores clave para detectar desviaciones, tendencias emergentes y riesgos potenciales. 10. Reportar a nivel directivo. Comunicar el progreso, resultados e impacto de la agenda analítica a la alta dirección con reportes ejecutivos orientados a decisiones. Estudios Licenciatura en áreas económico-administrativas. Experiencia en análisis de portafolio de crédito, riesgo y métricas financieras. Conocimientos técnicos. Dominio avanzado de SQL, Python o R. Metodologías de inferencia causal, experimentación y análisis estadístico. Plataformas de datos y herramientas de visualización (Tableau, Power BI o similares). Comunicación de análisis complejos a audiencias no técnicas. Habilidades Entendimiento profundo del dominio de crédito individual y portafolio. Priorización estratégica y gestión de equipos analíticos. Comunicación ejecutiva y orientación al negocio. Rigor analítico y pensamiento causal aplicado a crédito. Colaboración cross-funcional con stakeholders de riesgo y negocio. Postúlate hoy y forma parte de Crediclub.

Title: Product Innovation Intern

The strength of the international business lies in its ability to tailor its products to meet unique dealer needs, consumer preferences and national require. GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses in local markets. In this role, you will contribute to activities related to market intelligence, innovation initiatives, experimentation routines, product performance tracking, and knowledge-sharing forums. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams and country stakeholders to help structure information, prepare materials, monitor progress, and support the continuous improvement of the Product Innovation framework. This position is ideal for a student interested in leveraging data and analytics to support business decisions, improve reporting, and contribute to the development and growth of financial products across multiple international markets. In This Role You Will Support the organization and tracking of Product Innovation initiatives across International Operations markets. Help prepare summaries, presentations, and materials for product innovation routines, forums, and leadership updates. Assist with market intelligence, competitive intelligence, and benchmarking activities to identify opportunities, trends, and learnings across countries. Support the documentation of experimentation activities, including problem statements, assumptions, hypotheses, learnings, and next steps. Support the enhancement, maintenance, and automation of dashboards and reporting tools used to track product performance, innovation initiatives, and business results. Help maintain updated repositories, trackers, dashboards, and shared files related to product innovation initiatives. Assist with the consolidation and analysis of product performance information and initiative status updates. Support the preparation of knowledge-sharing materials so countries can leverage success cases, challenges, and lessons learned. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across countries and functions to collect, validate, and organize information. Contribute to process improvement efforts related to product innovation governance, reporting, analytics, and documentation. Support the development of executive presentations, KPI reporting, dashboards, and business reviews for leadership audiences. Qualifications What makes you an ideal candidate? Availability to work Monday to Friday , from 8am to 3pm (Hybrid) Advanced Excel skills, including data manipulation, pivot tables, formulas, dashboards, and reporting automation. Interest in analyzing data and transforming information into meaningful business insights. Knowledge in Power BI, including dashboard creation, report enhancement, data visualization, and performance reporting. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, opportunities, and performance insights. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams. Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal). Interest in financial services, lending products, customer experience, innovation, and business growth. Additional Knowledge And Skills Working effectively within an AI enabled environment: Ability to use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support daily work Skills in evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, compliance, and bias Experience integrating AI into workflows to improve efficiency or insights Familiarity with AI assisted research, summarization, and content generation Understanding of responsible AI use, including ethics and data protection Experience & Education Current student pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, International Business, or a related field. Title: Business Analyst - Shared Services

This extensive range supports our customers across the industrial lifecycle of designing, building and maintaining equipment and operations. We enhance their experience through a tailored service model, leveraging our efficient physical, digital and process infrastructure sustainably. We combine a technically led and digitally enabled approach with an exceptional team of experts; ultimately, it’s our people that make the difference. Our purpose, making amazing happen for a better world, reflects our focus on delivering results for people, planet and profit. About The Role Role Purpose The core purpose of this role is to provide data and insight across the Global Shared Services functions, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Order Processing. This will drive visibility of key performance indicators and improved efficiencies across each operational area. The person will be responsible for creating, developing, and maintaining reports using the various analytical toolsets available to RS Group. The role will also be customer facing, so will need a person who is able to deliver insight, actions, and training to various levels of stakeholders across GSBS. Example Responsibilities: Assist the Head of Performance & Planning role by providing data and insight to the GSBS Management team and GSBS Operations VP, SVP of GSBS End-to-end role within BI development - gathering requirements, building/designing a scope, meetings with stakeholders, testing, implementing, documentation, delivering workshops, maintenance Report Automation Service Level Analysis Productivity Analysis Able to manage own workload Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and deliver reports/dashboards for GSBS Operational Performance to generate actionable insights, recommendations for improvement and tracking of our ongoing progress. Work in partnership with GSBS Operational teams to develop new reporting needs and maintain existing reporting. Source and assemble large, complex data sets to solve business problems in new and innovative ways. Provide expert advice on BI best practices, guidance, and direction to our customers. Manage key projects identified including effectively communicating progress, risks, issues and dependencies when there is likely to be any impact on the overall programme. Owns business requirements gathering and outlining requirements, definitions, scope (In & Out), current & future process, and exception Processes & reporting/tracking capabilities. Highlighting areas of concern to Senior Leadership Team and Business Stakeholders Provide customer support and training to business users in use of KPIs while identifying knowledge gaps to increase awareness and understanding of metrics, processes, and operational requirements. Strong relationships will also be needed with our Group Data team to ensure knowledge and skills are transferred between the teams. Candidate Requirements Qualifications and Skills: Essential: 3+ years of experience in a similar role working with stakeholders to provide analytical outputs (reports, dashboards, etc) Degree level education or equivalent experience and knowledge in analytical roles (Computer systems engineer or information systems, Actuary, Data analytics / Statistics / Math, Business Administration) Must demonstrate the ability to engage and influence key stakeholders at all levels effectively An excellent understanding of the technical business insight solution that RS Group has invested in, specifically SAP Business Objects and how it relates to BW / other data warehouses applications and knowledge of SAP Business Warehouse 7.x and how it relates to SAP ERP and other legacy applications within RS Group Highly experienced in using Business Objects Toolsets/Power BI Highly proficient in data extraction, manipulation and knowledge of statistics and statistical packages and languages such as SQL, Python, VBA Strong proficiency in English Proven track record of managing execution by planning and prioritising work which meets commitments and provides direction Experience of effective stakeholder management in challenging situations Excellent communication skills when interacting at all levels with the ability to listen and to communicate ideas confidently yet sensitively Strong analytical capabilities and competent in interpreting and using data to substantiate decisions and drive others to make better and clearer decisions through relevant information Results focused, ambitious, creative, and confident. Able to translate complex concepts into clearly understood delivery plans. Able to challenge the status quo, to influence and drive change Culturally sensitive with the ability to operate effectively in a global role Autonomous with an inquisitive manner Desirable: Experience of interaction between teams across geographies Understanding of key GSBS operational metrics (aged debt, cash conversion, customer orders, debtor days, payment on time, etc.)

Title: Experimentation Specialist
Description: Propósito: Responsable de gestionar y ejecutar el proceso de experimentación end-to-end en mercado, recabando evidencia clara que determine si el producto tiene el valor suficiente para integrarse a la propuesta de valor de la vertical de negocio (Retail, Gasolineras, Salud, F&B, etc.). Esta posición es dueña de diseñar y conducir la experimentación con comercios reales hasta definir casos de éxito, entregando al Solutions Lead evidencia que valide el incremento de valor generado al negocio. Participa en foros de definición de iniciativas; lidera y defiende las actividades de experiemntación que de ahí resultan ante diversos equipos internos, sin una autoridad jerárquica, pero inspirando y colaborando con la organización. Responsabilidades: Diseño y gestión del experimento. Formula la(s) hipótesis, define la línea base contra la que se va a comparar y fija los criterios de éxito antes de arrancar. Además, gestiona entre todos los equipos el diseño del experimento, siguiendo una metodología colaborativa desde la etapa de ideación, en conjunto con el Research & Insights Lead. Definición e instrumentación. Define los PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) y los KPIs que puedan medir con veracidad y objetividad los resultados del experimento (eventos, reportes y calidad de dato) y que permitan determinar si el experimento se debe iterar, escalar o descartar. Conducción del desarrollo. Impulsa junto a los DEVs el diseño, la preparación y ejecución del piloto: lleva el ritmo del desarrollo y sus rituales, y les entrega hipótesis a experimentar y criterio de éxito. Operación del piloto. Diseña, junto con el equipo comercial, el pitch a los comercios, es responsable del seguimiento durante la prueba y coordina con las funciones transversales durante toda la operación. Lectura económica del piloto. Compara lo comprometido en las etapas iniciales (adopción, ticket, costo, margen) contra lo observado en el experimento, y determina si el resultado sostiene el caso de negocio. Riesgo y dependencias. Resuelve, antes de lanzar los pilotos, las reglas sobre qué datos se comparten con terceros, y los contratos correspondientes, apoyándose además en Comercial, Operaciones, Finanzas, Seguridad, CX y Legal como asesores funcionales según la dependencia de que se trate. Qué buscamos: 7 a 10 años en producto y experimentación, con al menos una etapa de operación real (no solo consultoría) y haber llevado el producto a manos de clientes reales. Criterio técnico para definir instrumentación, experiencia en diseñar un experimento a nivel negocio y producto (UX/UI) e interpretar los resultados, y experiencia operando en campo (alta de comercios, incidencias del piloto), no solo escribiendo definiciones. Capacidad de liderar sin jerarquía: participa y defiende sus iniciativas en foros de liderazgo y comités, sin una autoridad jerárquica, pero inspirando y colaborando con la organización. Capacidad amplia de comunicación verbal y escrita para presentar iniciativas, el producto a experimentar y sus resultados. Deseable: transacciones, pagos, servicios financieros, fintech o retail. En Spin estamos comprometidos con construir un lugar de trabajo diverso e inclusivo. Creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades y promovemos un entorno libre de discriminación por motivos de raza, origen nacional, género, identidad de género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra condición legalmente protegida.

Title: Practicante Analista de Innovación (Venture Clienting & Innovation Research)
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Sobre VCL studio Las mejores ideas no siempre nacen dentro de una empresa. Por eso cada vez más corporativos apuestan por la innovación abierta y buscan innovar de la mano de startups, lo que se conoce como corporate venturing. Una de sus formas más ágiles es el Venture Clienting: en lugar de invertir en una startup, la empresa se vuelve su cliente y prueba su solución en un reto real. En VCL studio hacemos justo eso: conectamos a corporativos con las startups correctas y convertimos esos pilotos en resultados medibles de negocio. Somos un equipo pequeño y AI heavy users: usamos inteligencia artificial todos los días y buscamos constantemente optimizar nuestro trabajo e incrementar nuestra productividad con ella. El rol Como Practicante de Venture Clienting & Innovation Research serás parte activa de un equipo pequeño que trabaja con corporativos en México y LATAM. Tu trabajo combinará investigación y scouting de startups a nivel global con soporte operativo al equipo: desde la gestión del CRM y el seguimiento a leads hasta la preparación de materiales para clientes. Tendrás exposición directa al director general y responsabilidad real desde el primer mes. Aprenderás cómo operan los corporativos más relevantes de la región y conocerás de primera mano startups de alto impacto de todo el mundo. Qué vas a hacer Hacer investigación y scouting de startups a nivel global para retos concretos de clientes, y presentar los hallazgos de forma clara. Gestionar el CRM (HubSpot) y dar seguimiento a leads y al pipeline comercial. Investigar cuentas objetivo y armar listas de prospección. Preparar presentaciones y materiales para clientes corporativos. Apoyar el análisis de impacto de negocio de los proyectos que ejecutamos. Dar soporte operativo al equipo en el día a día (ClickUp, Drive y automatizaciones). Preparar research y primeros borradores de contenido de thought leadership. Usar y orquestar herramientas de IA en tu día a día para investigar, analizar y automatizar el trabajo. No vas a pasar el día armando bases o presentaciones a mano: para eso nos apoyamos en la IA. Tu valor está en entender, analizar y ayudar a tomar mejores decisiones. Lo que buscamos Estudiante de 6.° a 8.° semestre de Negocios, Innovación, Ingeniería o afines. Habilidades de investigación y análisis cualitativo y cuantitativo: evaluar soluciones de startups y tendencias de mercado, y estructurar la información en presentaciones claras. Buena comunicación para colaborar con el equipo, clientes y startups. Que ya uses IA en tu día a día para investigar, analizar, crear o automatizar. Interés genuino por la tecnología, las startups y la innovación, con ganas constantes de aprender. Proactividad y ownership: resuelves problemas sin esperar instrucciones paso a paso. Dominio del español e inglés. Dominio de Google Slides, Sheets y Docs. Deseable: ClickUp y HubSpot, o disposición para aprenderlos. Que te identifiques con nuestros cuatro pilares: proactividad, comunicación, persistencia y sentido humano. No esperamos que llegues sabiendo todo ni que ya conozcas Venture Clienting: tendrás capacitación y acompañamiento del equipo. Detalles Medio tiempo: 20–25 horas por semana. Presencial en San Pedro Garza García, N.L., con flexibilidad para trabajo híbrido. Nota: esta práctica es una etapa de inducción y aprendizaje. Buscamos a alguien con interés real en el Venture Clienting y la innovación corporativa, que la vea como el primer paso para incorporarse de tiempo completo al equipo al graduarse. Si quieres aprender donde la innovación se convierte en resultados, te queremos conocer. Where Venture Clienting gets done. Fecha de cierre: esta vacante estará abierta hasta el 5 de noviembre de 2026. Contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados a más tardar durante la semana posterior al cierre.

Title: Director, Commercial Operations
Description: Overview About the Role & Team IDC is seeking a Director, Commercial Operations to provide senior-level insight and operating leadership across some of our most important commercial priorities. This person will have a broad view across the Commercial portfolio and work directly with senior leaders to understand performance, identify where we need to go deeper, and shape the decisions and actions that follow. They will not simply respond to questions or report results. We expect them to recognize the questions we should be asking, develop a point of view grounded in the data and business context, and bring forward clear recommendations. Much of the work will cross functions and organizational boundaries. The Director will bring senior leaders and teams together around complex issues, challenge assumptions when needed, create clarity around what needs to happen next, and help drive action on priorities that matter to the business. What You’ll Do Commercial Performance & Portfolio Analysis Own analysis of key Commercial KPIs, trends, variances, and performance drivers across the portfolio. Develop an integrated view across regions, segments, teams, and strategic priorities to identify where performance is changing, where risk is emerging, and where deeper attention is warranted. Bring together data from multiple sources, reconcile inconsistencies, and investigate results that do not immediately make sense. Look beyond headline numbers to understand underlying drivers, patterns, risks, and opportunities. Connect signals across different parts of the business to identify broader implications that may not be visible when each area is viewed independently. Strategic Insights & Decision Support Turn complex data and operational information into clear insights, implications, and recommended actions for senior leadership. Take broad or ambiguous commercial questions, determine what needs to be understood, and structure the analysis required to get there. Develop a point of view grounded in evidence and challenge assumptions when the data points somewhere else. Advise leadership on critical commercial priorities by clarifying what is working, what is not, what has changed, and what decisions or trade-offs may be required. Create executive reporting, business reviews, analyses, and presentations that make important issues easier to understand and act on. Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence Partner with senior leaders and teams across Commercial, Revenue Operations, Finance, Marketing, IT, and other functions on priorities that span organizational boundaries. Bring together the right information, perspectives, and expertise to create a shared understanding of complex issues. Build strong working relationships across departments and work through conflicting information, unclear ownership, or different points of view. Create clarity around the inputs, decisions, actions, and deliverables needed from each contributor. Hold owners accountable for commitments and follow through when required information, decisions, or actions are missing. Surface unresolved issues early and bring the right leaders together when progress requires broader coordination or intervention. Turning Insight Into Action Work with senior leaders and business owners to translate findings into clear actions and expected outcomes. Evaluate whether actions taken are actually changing the result and identify when a different response is needed. Recognize when an issue requires deeper analysis, a different approach, or senior leadership attention. Help leadership focus on the issues that matter most and make sure important findings do not stop at the report, dashboard, or presentation. Reporting & Process Improvement Continuously improve the reporting, metrics, dashboards, and analytical approaches used to understand Commercial performance and strategic priorities. Identify reporting and operational processes that are manual, fragmented, inconsistent, or harder than they need to be. Work with partner teams to improve data quality, standardization, automation, and recurring workflows. Build practical, scalable tools and processes that give leadership better visibility into the business and make it easier to identify issues and act on them. What Success Looks Like We are looking for someone who is analytical, commercially minded, and naturally curious. When something changes, they want to understand why. When the numbers do not add up, they keep digging until they do. They also need the judgment and credibility to operate with senior leaders across functions. This person should be comfortable with challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, holding others accountable, and forming a point of view even when the answer is not obvious. Above all, we want someone senior leadership can trust to understand the business, identify what matters, and help shape the actions we take on our most important commercial priorities. What You Bring 8–12+ years of experience in Commercial Operations, Business Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy, Transformation, Analytics, or a related field. Strong analytical skills and experience working with business performance data, KPIs, trends, and operational metrics. Demonstrated ability to move from data to insight, understand broader business implications, and develop clear recommendations. Experience advising senior leaders on high-priority business questions, strategic initiatives, or performance issues. Experience developing executive reporting, business reviews, analyses, and presentations for senior leadership. Strong ability to structure ambiguous questions, develop hypotheses, and work through complex problems independently. Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large or complex data sets. Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn detailed information into clear, concise executive communication. Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence senior stakeholders across multiple functions without direct authority. Experience improving reporting, workflows, or operating processes through better design, standardization, tools, or automation. Familiarity with Salesforce and business intelligence or reporting platforms is preferred. Strong communication, judgment, organization, and follow-through. Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and operate with a high degree of independence. Why This Role Stands Out At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions. Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand. Equal Opportunity Employer IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify. If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range.

Title: Pricing & Revenue Growth Manager
Industries: Food and Beverage Manufacturing, Food and Beverage Services, and Manufacturing
Description: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Únete a nuestra misión de liderar el futuro de Snacking. Hazlo con orgullo. Asistir en la ejecución del flujo de trabajo de la gestión de ingresos, para ayudar a optimizar el retorno de la inversión en nuestras actividades de gasto comercial Cómo contribuirás Tus tareas: Trabajar con equipos de clientes para hacer un seguimiento de la evolución de los KPI de ingresos Completar evaluaciones posteriores acerca de las acciones promocionales en colaboración con finanzas y marketing Dar apoyo al Manager de Customer Planning, proporcionando informes regulares que incluyan seguimiento de volumen, gastos comerciales, % promocionado, seguimiento de actualizaciones estacionales Supervisar la conversión en ingresos de cualquier aumento de los precios de coste Trabajar con los equipos de clientes, finanzas y ventas para asegurar que todos los gastos de promoción en el sistema se acumulan correctamente Asistir a los estudios de previsión de negocio para comprender la dinámica de los clientes e identificar las oportunidades y los riesgos del plan Aprobar las actividades promocionales de acuerdo con las directrices, con revisiones periódicas de los gastos de promoción Qué aportarás El deseo de impulsar tu futuro y acelerar tu carrera junto con los siguientes conocimientos y experiencia: Visión financiera y comercial Reducción de la complejidad utilizando un enfoque analítico, disciplinado y de colaboración Sintetizar de datos provenientes de múltiples puntos en una sola posición integral Organización y priorización Capacidad de resolución de problemas Búsqueda de soluciones nuevas e innovadoras Se valorará la experiencia en sector de bienes de consumo de rápida evolución o productos empaquetados de consumo Se valorará el conocimiento del consumidor y la categoría More About This Role Promotional capability within our Revenue Growth Management (RGM) function. This role will be the architect and leader of that capability — owning end-to-end promotional planning, execution, and optimization across all categories, all channels, and all customers in the Mexican market, with a strong emphasis on the Modern Trade / Autoservicios channel . They will lead the transfer and redesign of the promo process from another area, and drive adoption of new ways of working across Sales, Trade, Marketing, Finance, and RGM. What you need to know about this position: Plan and execute the promotional plan across all customers, channels, and categories. Own the planning cycle and ensure monthly execution discipline across the full portfolio. Land the end-to-end (E2E) Promo Playbook: governance, Ways of Working (WoW), golden rules, and methodology. Lead post-mortem analyses of promotional events, maintain a learning repository, and continuously update golden rules and the living playbook. Drive a rigorous Gross-to-Net and P&L mindset in all promotional decisions. Connect promotional strategy with Pricing, PPA (Price Pack Architecture), Channel Strategy, Brand Strategy, and overall business priorities. Act as the bridge between commercial and financial perspectives, ensuring promo investments are aligned with the broader RGM agenda Build credibility and trust to become the go-to voice on promotional effectiveness. Lead the transfer of the promo process from another area; redesign it and ensure cross-functional adoption (Sales, Trade, Marketing, Finance, RGM). Build from the ground up: process, governance, tools, and organizational structure for the new Promo capability. Lead and develop a team of analysts, building their capabilities and ensuring they grow Education / Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Administration, Business, or related fields. Job specific requirements: 5–8+ years of experience in Revenue Growth Management, Trade Marketing, Commercial Planning, or Commercial Finance within CPG/FMCG. Hands-on experience with Promo / TPM tools (e.g., TPM systems, promo optimization platforms, or equivalent). Strong analytical and financial profile: comfortable with P&L management, Gross-to-Net waterfalls, ROI analysis, and promotional post-mortems. Knowledge of Trade & Category Management (Catman): shopper insights, shelf strategy, and how promo connects to in-store execution. Fluent in the language of commercial analytics: price elasticity, price ladders, price points, promotional lift, cannibalization, and incrementality. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing without direct authority. Strong people leadership skills: ability to develop talent, delegate effectively, and build high-performing teams. Work schedule: Full time No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary Mondelez México has been in the country since 1927 and currently employs 6,000 wonderful people. Our diverse portfolio includes iconic and mouth-watering global brands such as Trident , Oreo , Philadelphia , and local jewels like Clorets and Bubbaloo . We are leaders in the making of cream cheese, powdered beverages and confections—in fact, we make seven out of every 10 chewing gums consumed by Mexicans. Our growth is supported by our cutting-edge manufacturing facilities, such as our Puebla Plant and Nuevo León HUB, which are the largest gums, candies and biscuits factories in the world in terms of volume. You can buy are products in 900,000 places in Mexico. We are also home to one of the 11 technology centers Mondelez International has worldwide, a specialized gum and candy facility that places us at the forefront of innovation and development in the country and drives our purpose to lead the future of snacking. We are pioneers in the country in work-life balance practices such as extended maternity leave, open spaces, remote work and flexible working hours. Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Job Type Regular Category Planning & Activation Sales

Title: Sr. Business Architect (CX)
Description: About Klar We're turning one of the world's largest underbanked markets into something fairer, simpler, and more transparent. 7 million users served since 2019. Uber's first global credit card, built right here in Mexico. Klar Empresarial, a brand-new B2B solution — Klar Empresarial — bringing agile credit and smart accounts to SMEs who've been ignored by traditional banks for too long. And a full banking license on the horizon, because our customers asked for it and we listened. We move fast, we think big, and we go all in, because as our CEO puts it: "Growing doesn't always mean going further. Sometimes it means going deeper." Behind all of it is a team of 30+ nationalities, working across Mexico City, Berlin, and Argentina, obsessed with building financial products that are simpler, faster, and fairer than anything that came before. This is Klar, and we're seeking the people who'll write the next chapter. Our people If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed to a team that is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here! and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here! Our values Ownership - We own our successes & our failures as a team. Excellence - We do everything to the best of our ability & always seek to achieve a new level of excellence in our work. Inclusion - We believe we are stronger together and actively work to promote a safe, diverse, inclusive, and respectful culture. Customer Obsession - We understand the value Klar can bring to its customers & it’s always at the forefront of our decisions. Klarity - We communicate clearly & with authenticity. It’s in our name & it’s what we do. The position and your daily adventures As a Senior CX Specialist, you will play a key role in evolving and scaling our Customer Experience operation. You will own initiatives end-to-end, using data, automation, and AI to identify opportunities, design solutions, and improve both the customer experience and operational efficiency. This is a full-time position based in our Mexico City office with a hybrid model, therefore we are looking forward to seeing you in our office 2-3 times per week. What you can expect: As a Senior CX Specialist, you will play a key role in evolving and scaling our Customer Experience operation. You will own initiatives end-to-end, using data, automation, and AI to identify opportunities, design solutions, and improve both the customer experience and operational efficiency. Your main responsibilities will include: End-to-End Project Ownership: Lead complex CX projects from problem identification and analysis through solution design, implementation, measurement, and iteration. Projects may include automation pilots, new support flows, escalation frameworks, QA improvements, and other initiatives aimed at improving and scaling the operation. AI & Automation: Design, test, and implement automated workflows and AI-powered solutions that improve customer journeys, increase self-service, and reduce operational effort and resolution times. Monitor AI performance and partner with Data & AI teams to continuously improve existing solutions and launch new capabilities. Data-Driven CX Optimization: Analyze operational KPIs, contact drivers, customer behavior, and trends to identify opportunities and root causes. Translate insights into prioritized initiatives and measure their impact on customer experience and operational performance. Scalable Process Design: Map and optimize CX processes end-to-end, identifying opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and self-service. Design solutions that enable the operation to scale without proportionally increasing complexity or manual effort. Knowledge Management: Own and continuously improve the knowledge used by both AI and support agents, ensuring content is accurate, clear, structured, and aligned with current products and processes. Complex Case & Root-Cause Analysis: Support the resolution of cases that require deeper expertise, analysis, or cross-functional coordination. Use complex and recurring cases as a source of insights to identify systemic issues and drive structural improvements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Operations, Data & AI, and other stakeholders to solve customer pain points at the root cause and successfully implement high-impact improvements. What we are looking for: Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline or analytical field. Analytical & Data Skills: Experience with Excel and intermediate knowledge of SQL and Python. Using data to investigate problems, identify patterns, generate actionable insights, and support decision-making. AI & Automation Mindset: Genuine curiosity and interest in AI, automation, and emerging tools, with a desire to apply them to real operational and customer problems. Process & Scalability Mindset: Strong ability to understand complex processes, identify inefficiencies, and design simpler, more scalable solutions. Project Management: Ability to structure and drive initiatives end-to-end, coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and follow through from problem identification to measurable results. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex problems and findings into clear, simple, and actionable recommendations. Collaboration: Comfortable working across teams and disciplines, proactively seeking input, challenging ideas constructively, and bringing the right people together to solve problems. English Proficiency: Advanced English level, as most internal communication at Klar takes place in English. Our offer to you: Competitive salary based on performance and experience Chance of earning Klar stock options 15 days of paid vacation per year; plus extended maternity and paternity leaves Vacation premium 30 days of Christmas bonus Food vouchers Medical Insurance Computer device Wellhub subscription to offer mental and physical health Sponsored coaching and therapy sessions via a Mental Health Platform A modern centrally located office in Mexico City with free drinks, snacks, and regular social events International work environment with amazing and highly skilled people A world class team that helps you evolve your skills in areas you're interested in Klar is a safe place for everyone! We trust our highly skilled and diverse team and we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for new talents to flourish. We value diversity and welcome all applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation and identity. Should you require any accommodations through the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know how we can help!

Title: Senior Specialist, Product Management
Industries: Financial Services, IT Services and IT Consulting, and Technology, Information and Internet
Description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title And Summary Senior Specialist, Product Management About The Role The Senior Specialist, Product Management within the Network Services Team will play a key role in driving revenue optimization, value realization, and strategic growth across the Network Services portfolio. This role combines financial analysis, customer insights, product management, and strategic thinking to identify opportunities that improve revenue performance and strengthen the value delivered to customers. The successful candidate will conduct in-depth financial modeling and customer analysis to assess pricing impacts and opportunities, support the identification and development of strategic initiatives aimed at increasing and optimizing revenue, and provide insights that enable informed business decisions. The role will also support the tracking of recurring revenue, revenue assurance, and the development of materials that clearly communicate recommendations, business cases, and key insights. Working closely with stakeholders across global and regional teams, the Senior Specialist will help drive alignment on pricing constructs, value propositions, and revenue-generating initiatives. This position requires strong analytical capabilities, regional business acumen, commercial orientation, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions, geographies, and cultures. Key Responsibilities Analyze existing and proposed pricing constructs, pricing drivers, customer usage patterns, and commercial models to identify opportunities for revenue growth and optimization. Develop and maintain financial models to quantify the revenue and economic impact of pricing changes, product initiatives, and strategic opportunities. Support the development and implementation of pricing strategies and revenue-generating initiatives aligned with business objectives. Partner with product, commercial, finance, sales, and regional teams to drive alignment and adoption of pricing strategies. Translate complex analytical findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations. Support the tracking and analysis of recurring revenue and key revenue performance indicators. All About You Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field. Relevant professional experience in consulting, corporate strategy, business intelligence, business line management, product management, finance, pricing, or a related analytical/commercial function. Experience managing relationships with clients, customers, or internal stakeholders. Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to work with financial and business data. Logical and structured approach to problem solving, with a strong affinity for numerical analysis. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Strong business and commercial acumen, with the ability to connect analysis to business outcomes. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Fluency in English and the local office language, both written and verbal. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Title: Arquitecto de IA
Description: Job Description: Arquitecto de IA (AI Architect) Objetivo del puesto Diseñar y definir la arquitectura técnica de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning, traduciendo los requerimientos del negocio en componentes tecnológicos específicos, escalables, seguros y eficientes. Será responsable de determinar los servicios, componentes de software, infraestructura, integraciones y flujos de datos necesarios para implementar cada solución, asegurando su viabilidad técnica y alineación con los objetivos del negocio. Responsabilidades principales Diseñar arquitecturas técnicas para soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning y plataformas de datos. Traducir los requerimientos funcionales y necesidades del negocio en diseños de arquitectura, componentes de software e infraestructura. Definir la arquitectura de datos, incluyendo modelos de datos, flujos de información, almacenamiento, procesamiento e integración entre sistemas. Diseñar e implementar estrategias de integración mediante APIs, microservicios y servicios de nube. Evaluar y seleccionar servicios de AWS para soportar soluciones de IA, procesamiento de datos y despliegue de modelos. Definir patrones de diseño, estándares técnicos y buenas prácticas para garantizar la escalabilidad, disponibilidad, seguridad y mantenibilidad de las soluciones. Diseñar mecanismos de orquestación de datos y servicios, asegurando la interoperabilidad entre los diferentes componentes tecnológicos. Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning y áreas de negocio para garantizar la correcta implementación de la arquitectura. Identificar riesgos técnicos, dependencias, limitaciones de infraestructura y oportunidades de optimización durante el diseño de las soluciones. Estimar los componentes, servicios y recursos tecnológicos necesarios para la implementación de cada caso de uso. Documentar diagramas de arquitectura, decisiones técnicas, especificaciones de integración y lineamientos de implementación. Participar activamente en la definición técnica de los casos de uso, manteniendo una participación acorde con la demanda y complejidad de los proyectos. Requisitos indispensables Experiencia sólida en diseño de arquitectura de soluciones tecnológicas, arquitectura de datos y plataformas de IA/ML. Experiencia diseñando soluciones que integren múltiples componentes de software, servicios de nube y fuentes de datos. Conocimientos sólidos de arquitectura de datos, modelado de datos y diseño de flujos de información. Experiencia en diseño e integración de APIs, servicios web y arquitecturas basadas en microservicios. Experiencia en plataformas cloud, preferentemente AWS. Conocimiento de patrones de arquitectura, principios de diseño de software y buenas prácticas de integración. Experiencia en orquestación de procesos, servicios o flujos de datos. Capacidad para convertir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas, diagramas de arquitectura y planes de implementación. Habilidad para comunicar decisiones arquitectónicas y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios. Conocimientos técnicos deseables Servicios de AWS relacionados con datos, analítica e Inteligencia Artificial, como Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, AWS Glue, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock y servicios de integración. Arquitecturas cloud-native, serverless y basadas en microservicios. Integración de modelos de Machine Learning y soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial generativa. Diseño de pipelines de datos y arquitecturas ETL/ELT. Herramientas de orquestación y automatización de procesos. Conocimientos de seguridad, gobierno de datos, observabilidad y optimización de costos en la nube. Experiencia con soluciones escalables y ambientes productivos de IA/ML.

Title: Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) Intern
Description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Visa’s Internship Program provides an immersive, 12-month journey where you’ll work on impactful projects that drive Visa’s mission forward. As a Visa intern, you’ll build valuable connections across the organization, sharpen your communication and business acumen, and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, global environment. Throughout the program, you’ll have exclusive access to interactive workshops and learning sessions designed to deepen your expertise, expand your industry knowledge, and elevate your professional skillset. You won’t just be learning, you’ll be contributing, collaborating, and innovating every step of the way. The experience culminates in an exciting final presentation, where you’ll showcase your project achievements, share key insights, and present your recommendations to Visa’s leaders and stakeholders. This is your chance to demonstrate your business impact, highlight your personal growth, and align your work with Visa’s vision for the future. Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) is Visa’s advisory and consulting organization. It helps banks, fintechs, merchants, acquirers, governments, and other payment ecosystem participants improve growth, profitability, customer engagement, and payment performance through a combination of consulting, data analytics, economics, and implementation support. As a VCA Intern, you will contribute to initiatives that help internal and external stakeholders achieve strategic objectives. You will have opportunities to take on meaningful responsibilities, expand your skills, and gain exposure to different areas of the business while working with experienced professionals on impactful projects. All Visa roles require digital fluency , including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. Some job duties and projects could include, but are not limited to: Engage with VCA team members and other internal partners to support consulting engagements Contribute to activities across the consulting lifecycle and leverage AI tools where appropriate Assist with business development through market research and proposal preparation Support project implementation and help document best practices for global knowledge sharing Coordinate logistics and operational activities for the VCA team in Mexico Participate in client engagement areas such as portfolio optimization, product design and launch, digital strategy, and transformation Prepare materials for internal governance updates and thought leadership initiatives Support alignment of the consulting practice with internal processes and operational standards Assist with executive communications, including drafting content and managing communication trackers Collaborate on deliverables that help maintain high-quality client engagement Remember, at Visa, we see our employees as our most valuable asset and we are excited to support and witness your growth within our organization. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, International Business, or a related field, with an expected graduation date between November 2027 and March 2028 Interpersonal and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across teams Interest in financial services, strategy, and emerging technologies Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and present insights Clear, structured communication skills in both written and verbal formats Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and comfort learning new technologies Preferred Qualifications Bilingual in Spanish and English Experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills to business challenges Ability to adapt to ambiguity and learn quickly in a dynamic environment Familiarity with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for data and presentation development Awareness of AI tools and a willingness to integrate them into day-to-day work Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Title: Sr Finance Analyst, 3P Finance MX
Description: Description Ever wondered if the money a company invests actually works? In this role, you'll be the one who answers that question — and your findings will directly shape how one of the world's largest marketplaces allocates resources to grow. You'll join a high-visibility finance team that sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, evaluating investment programs from business case all the way through real-world results. This is not a reporting role — you'll be expected to have opinions, challenge assumptions, and influence decisions at the senior leadership level. Key job responsibilities What You'll Be Doing Building investment evaluation frameworks that connect business actions (seller growth, selection expansion, promotional activity) to financial outcomes (revenue, margin, efficiency) — and tracking whether the connection holds in practice Developing ROI models with clear pre-deployment thresholds, success metrics, and kill criteria so the team can make fast, disciplined capital allocation decisions Running a regular investment governance cadence — synthesizing performance signals across a multi-million dollar portfolio and delivering sharp recommendations to senior leadership Partnering with business, operations, and marketing teams to align on assumptions and hold everyone accountable to shared targets Identifying what's not working and making the case to reallocate or shut it down — portfolio discipline is as important as finding new opportunities About The Team Inclusive team culture At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust. Work Life Balance We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. Mentorship & Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. Title: Senior Software Development Engineer (Tech L), DSO (Demand Science Optimization)
Description: Description Senior Software Development Engineer driving the re-architecture of Amazon Devices' pricing and assortment planning platform — the system that decides what devices sell where, when, and at what price, across every Amazon device sold worldwide. This role owns the design and delivery of a new domain-modeled system: collapsing a fragmented legacy input pipeline into an automated platform that determines pricing and retailer placement for over 21,000 products across 7 device families and 22+ countries. The team's scope is growing, and you will shape how it grows. What You Will Work On Setting technical direction and architecture across the services the team owns Raising the engineering bar through design review, code review, and operational standards Aligning with engineers on partner teams on shared interfaces and ownership boundaries Replacing recurring manual work with automation and better design Mentoring engineers as they grow into deeper technical ownership Key job responsibilities Design, build, and operate the most technically complex parts of the input layer, using AI-assisted development and agents to replace work that is manual today Set technical direction and architecture, including decisions to consolidate, rebuild, or retire systems Lead design and code reviews, and define the operational standards a service meets before the team owns it Partner with product managers, scientists, and engineers on other teams to turn requirements into designs and to align on shared interfaces and ownership boundaries Mentor engineers through design guidance, written documentation, and pairing A day in the life Your primary focus is the layer of inputs that Amazon's device planning, forecasting, and inventory systems all read from. A handful of services, and every build and allocation decision downstream depends on them agreeing. You're rebuilding that layer to easily allow stakeholders to manage a whole product line's inputs for high-impact decisions. You'll make the calls on what that architecture looks like. Title: Growth & Operations Specialist — Cuentista (venture Igeneris)
Description: Growth & Operations Lead — Cuentista (un venture de Igeneris) Acerca de nosotros En Igeneris nos dedicamos a transformar empresas. Diseñamos, construimos y escalamos negocios que revolucionan industrias, generando cientos de millones de euros en ingresos. Con el mejor talento y metodologías probadas, ayudamos a las empresas a crecer, diferenciarse y evolucionar de manera responsable. En Igeneris damos vida a las ideas. El venture: Cuentista Esta vacante es para uno de nuestros ventures en México. Cuentista es una startup mexicana que crea cuentos infantiles 100% personalizados con IA, donde el hijo o hija del cliente es el protagonista real de la historia: su nombre, su físico, su familia, su casa… y el reto que está viviendo en ese momento. No vendemos libros bonitos. Vendemos una herramienta para que mamás y papás acompañen los retos de verdad: la llegada de un hermanito, el primer día de escuela, una mudanza, una conversación difícil, aprender a nombrar lo que siente. Cuando el niño se ve a sí mismo en la historia, interioriza el mensaje y lo pone en práctica. Esa es la magia, y los números lo confirman. Cuentista ya está en el mercado, vendiendo y creciendo mes a mes. Entras a un negocio real, no a un piloto. El reto Hoy Cuentista funciona. El producto convierte, el cliente lo ama y la operación saca los pedidos. El siguiente capítulo es otro: pasar de una operación artesanal que funciona a una máquina que escala. Buscamos a la persona que tome ese reto de punta a punta. No es un puesto de "ejecutar un plan que ya existe". Es un puesto para construir el plan, automatizarlo y después liderarlo. Si te emociona la idea de que en 12 meses puedas señalar un canal de venta, un proceso automatizado y un equipo que no existían antes de que tú llegaras, sigue leyendo. Qué vas a hacer 1. Ser el dueño de la operación de Cuentista Que cada cuento salga a tiempo, con la calidad que prometimos y con el cliente contento. Desde que entra el pedido hasta que la familia abre el paquete. Vas a conocer el negocio desde adentro antes de reinventarlo. 2. Liderar la automatización de los procesos Hoy muchos pasos son manuales: revisión del cuento, cambios del cliente, seguimiento por WhatsApp. Tu misión es convertir eso en un sistema: menos toques humanos, más volumen, mismo nivel de calidad. Vas a trabajar de la mano del equipo de producto y tendrás toda la libertad para usar herramientas de IA y no-code. 3. Expandir nuestro GTM y hacer crecer el B2C Más allá de la pauta en Meta: alianzas con creadores, referidos, CRM y recompra sobre nuestra base de clientes, nuevos formatos, fechas clave (Día del Niño, Día del Padre, Navidad). Aquí experimentas, mides, matas lo que no funciona y escalas lo que sí. 4. Construir el canal B2B desde cero Museos, escuelas, fundaciones, hospitales, marcas que quieren regalar algo que sí se recuerda. Tenemos conversaciones abiertas y cero estructura. Es la apuesta con mayor potencial del negocio y va a ser tuya. 5. Liderar al equipo de operación Empiezas liderando un equipo pequeño que crecerá conforme escalemos. Formar, organizar, priorizar y sacar lo mejor de ellos es parte del trabajo. A quién buscamos Pedimos hambre, criterio y capacidad de resolver. Esta posición impactará el futuro de la empresa. Indispensable: ~2-4 años de experiencia en startups, growth, marketing digital, consultoría, operaciones o e-commerce (o un proyecto propio que hayas sacado adelante) Perfil generalista y resolutivo: igual te metes a arreglar un pedido atorado que a armar una propuesta comercial Cómodo con los números: sabes leer un funnel, calcular un CAC y decidir con datos, no con intuición Mentalidad de automatización: tu primer instinto ante una tarea repetitiva es preguntarte cómo eliminarla Uso natural de herramientas de IA y no-code en tu día a día Ownership real: te incomoda que algo esté mal y nadie lo esté arreglando Español nativo; inglés funcional Suma puntos: Experiencia vendiendo B2B o cerrando alianzas Haber trabajado con CRM, automatizaciones (Make, Zapier, n8n) o herramientas como Lovable Experiencia liderando aunque sea a una persona Haber vivido una etapa temprana de una startup (el caos no te asusta, te divierte) Qué ofrecemos Salario competitivo Un puesto con alcance real: operación, growth, tecnología y comercial en un solo rol Reportar directo a la dirección del venture, con acceso al ecosistema de Igeneris: metodología, expertos y la red de ventures y corporativos con los que trabajamos Un producto del que es fácil sentirse orgulloso: literalmente cambia la conversación en casa de miles de familias Esquema híbrido y flexibilidad real Una curva de aprendizaje brutal: en un año vas a haber hecho lo que en un corporativo toma cinco
